product.name: Superhuman Email App
product.description: An email client designed to improve email management speed and responsiveness for teams using Gmail or Outlook.

product.name: Superhuman AI
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that organizes inboxes, drafts emails in the user's voice, and automates email workflows.

product.name: Split Inbox
product.description: A feature that automatically categorizes incoming emails into prioritized tabs to help users focus on important messages.

product.name: Snippets
product.description: A tool to automate typing by inserting predefined phrases, paragraphs, or entire emails, including attachments and CC/BCC options.

product.name: Reminders
product.description: A feature that sets follow-up reminders for sent emails to ensure timely responses and prevent missed communications.

product.name: Team Comments
product.description: A collaboration feature enabling users to share live email views and comment directly on emails with teammates, even if they don't use Superhuman.
